Class CardStrategy

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.strategy.CardStrategy
Direct Known Subclasses:
AllSetFoodStrategy, ArtistEventStrategy, BuilderStrategy, DoubleBuilderPPStrategy, DoubleShamanPPStrategy, ExtraFoodOnFoodStrategy, ExtraPickStrategy, HuntEventStrategy, InventorsPairStrategy, InventorStrategy, ResourcePerCharStrategy, ShamanEventStrategy, ShamanSafetyStrategy, SustenanceStrategy, UpdateResourcesStrategy
public abstract class CardStrategy extends Object
The abstract base of the Strategy pattern used to model every card effect in the game.

Cards of the same Java type (Characters, Buildings, Events) can carry very different abilities; rather than subclassing each card, the concrete behavior is delegated to a CardStrategy. Each strategy combines two responsibilities: the effect(PlayerContext) to be executed (what the card does) and a RegistrationAction (when the effect is triggered). Immediate, "one-shot" effects (typically Characters) resolve as soon as they are invoked, while delayed effects (typically Buildings and Events) register themselves as listeners on a notificator and fire later, at a specific game phase.

  • Method Details

    • effect

      public abstract void effect(PlayerContext playerContext)
      Applies the concrete effect of this strategy to the game state.

      Each subclass implements its own behavior here, modifying the current player, all players or their tribes as required by the card's ability.

      Parameters:
      playerContext - the context granting access to the current player and to the full list of players involved in the effect

    • registerTo

      public void registerTo(NotificatorCenter nc, PlayerContext playerContext)
      Registers this strategy as a listener so that its effect(PlayerContext) can be triggered later by the appropriate notificator.

      The actual attachment is delegated to the RegistrationAction provided at construction time. If no registration action is present, the call is a no-op, which is the case for immediate effects that are resolved on the spot.

      Parameters:
      nc - the notificator center exposing the available trigger channels
      playerContext - the context of the player owning the card whose effect is registered
